links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of five LLMs on real-world HIV medication questions
links.effect: Composite scores: DeepSeek 4.47, Qwen 4.33, Kimi 4.24, Doubao 4.13, ChatGPT 3.41 (H=182.14, p<0.001); all models showed significant limitations on complex pharmaceutical inquiries.
links.quote: All models demonstrated significant limitations when handling complex pharmaceutical inquiries and cannot fully replace professional clinical pharmacists.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the baseline performance of five LLMs on real-world medication consultation queries evaluated offline by experts, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
